verdict.rationale: Fedora Workstation ships Boxes for one-click VM creation and built-in container tooling, which could be used as isolated sandbox environments separate from a production system, but there is no evidence of any AI-native testing workflow, staging/production data separation, or agent-specific sandbox tooling. missing for 10: explicit AI-native sandbox testing workflow, evidence of production-data isolation guarantees, and any hands-on corroboration of this use case.
